result.title: Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications
result.summary: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. Motivated by these properties, we introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and provide results demonstrating that AIQ achieves competitive accuracy compared to the industry-standard MX format across a diverse set of models and benchmarks at equivalent bit-per-parameter budgets. The experiments presented in this article employ algebraic integers of degree two (quadratic integers); generalizations to higher-order and, in particular, multidimensional algebraic integers promise even greater computational advantages and remain a promising direction for future work.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出代数整数数值格式（AINF），利用其可归约为纯整数运算、乘累加无误差的特性构建矩阵乘法引擎，并据此给出面向 LLM 推理的有损压缩格式 AIQ，在相同 bit-per-parameter 预算下与业界 MX 格式取得接近的精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 可核查线索是 AINF/AIQ 的「无误差乘累加 + 按用例定制数值格式」是否能为 latent 推理状态或 KV 缓存的低位宽压缩提供误差可控的方案，从而避免视觉证据在压缩中坍缩；但原文只涉及 LLM 量化，与多模态推理无直接关联。
